name: Ultrasonic Blitz
evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 100-Ki Strike Super counter. The user enters a counter stance for up to roughly two seconds; when struck, the counter teleports behind the attacker and performs its follow-up strike. The maintained PQ151 reward data assigns the skill to an explicit 50% Ultimate Finish roll. Exact counter-active frames, accepted attack classes, post-counter invulnerability, and damage scaling remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Unsupported exact frames, scaling formulas, probabilities, hidden conditions, and patch-independent balance values were not inferred.
Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
